newsitem.title: UK: UK's Infobank International Plc to seek AIM float.
newsitem.headline: UK's Infobank International Plc to seek AIM float.

text.p: Infobank International Holdings Plc said on Monday it plans to list on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) via a placing.

The company, which has developed a system using CD-ROM and on-line services for the sale of office supplies to businesses, said it plans to raise 8.0 million stg of new money with the issue, which will value it at 20.0 million stg.
Infobank will use the proceeds from the issue to expand its electronic commerce activities and software sales.
The adviser to the issue is English Trust and the broker is Collins Stewart. First dealings are expected in early February.
